excerpt.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
excerpt.en:

From what they have been able to piece together, our

scope.zh: V3人工审阅的局部事实已迁移；整条故事尚未在V4中完整复核。
scope.en: V3 manually reviewed facts migrated; the whole story has not yet been fully re-reviewed in V4.

note.zh: 地点没有固定先后；各项目要求科学家带领的科研船，基础研究时间180天。累计六份完成报告后定位母星。
note.en: Investigate in any order. Each project requires a science ship with a scientist and has a base duration of 180 days. Six completed reports locate the home system.

note.zh: 母星项目基础30天，要求科学家带领的科研船。完成时若尚无母星发现标志且目标未殖民，进入完整报告；否则进入另一结果。两者互斥，星系被定位并不等于母星已被调查。
note.en: The homeworld project takes 30 base days and requires a science ship with a scientist. On completion, the full report requires no homeworld-found flag and an uncolonized target; otherwise the alternative applies. Locating the system is not completing its investigation.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]发现了一些属于远古外星文明的文物！从这些遗物的年代来看，他们应该是在大约1200万年前活跃在这一区域的文明。
 
从我们所能拼凑起的情报中，科学家总结出这是一种自称为“沃陶姆恒星议会”的外星物种，他们长得像蠕虫的环节动物，大约3-4米长，彼此主要借助体节传递的振动进行交流。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from an ancient alien civilization on [From.GetName]! They must have been active in this region of space approximately 12 million years ago, judging by the age of the artifacts.

From what they have been able to piece together, our scientists theorize that these aliens, who called themselves the "Vultaum Star Assembly," were worm-like annelids, roughly 3 to 4 meters in length, that communicated with each other primarily through vibrations carried along their segmented bodies.

texts.zh:
我们在沃陶姆星群内找到了一些史前古器物。沃陶姆是在大约1200万年前活跃的外星文明。虽然这个种族确切的外观已经遗失在时间的迷雾中，但我们从它们的废墟可以推断出，他们是长度约三至四米的类蠕虫环节动物。他们似乎主要通过身体节段的震动来进行沟通。

如果我们能从他们的文明遗迹中找到足够的信息，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
texts.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Vultaum Star Assembly. They were an alien civilization that was active approximately 12 million years ago. Though their exact appearance has been lost in the mists of time, we have deduced from their ruins that they were worm-like annelids, roughly three to four meters in length. They seem to have communicated with each other primarily through vibrations carried along their segmented bodies.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

texts.zh: 有那么一瞬间，宇宙的构造似乎被扭曲了，然后在古老的沃陶姆遗珍周围伸展。正如我们所知道的那样，现实再次慢慢地展现自身，就在这时，一个短暂的时机出现了，一些规则在此刻可以被巧妙地改写。
texts.en: For an instant, the fabric of the universe seems to contort and then expand around the ancient Vultaum relic. As reality as we know it slowly reasserts itself, a brief window appears where some of the rules can be subtly rewritten.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Vultaum

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求沃陶姆的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the Vultaum to our own.

notes.zh: 首次秘密研究后，仅常规帝国的狂热唯物视角可继续深入。选择公开或压制会改变五天后各结果的权重；科学家须仍存在。三种后果互斥，不依次发生。
notes.en: Only the fanatic materialist perspective of a regular empire can pursue further research. Publishing or suppressing the findings changes the outcome weights after five days; the scientist must still exist. The three outcomes are alternatives.

texts.zh: 沃陶姆看上去在研究过程中采纳了一些不合逻辑的概念。他们在计算机以及虚拟世界领域的一些先进之处应该整合进我们的研究进程中。
texts.en: The Vultaum appear to have accepted some fundamentally illogical concepts in their research. Their research into computing and virtual worlds had some advances that we shall incorporate into our own processes.

texts.zh: 沃陶姆痴迷于现实和虚拟世界的概念。他们大多数发现对我们来说都毫无意义，但是至少他们对计算机的研究能够帮助我们。
texts.en: The Vultaum obsessed over the concept of reality and of virtual worlds. Most of their findings are useless to us, but at least their research into computing will aid our own.

texts.zh:
沃陶姆在计算机和虚拟世界领域是无可置疑的大师。我们可以使用他们的发现来极大帮助我们在该领域的研究。

然而，他们的结论却引发了我们的忧虑。乍一看来这些结论不仅缺陷重重还毫无意义，但是随着研究的深入，我们认为他们似乎发现了真相的冰山一角。

如果还想要进一步探究，我们将需要更多的时间和资源。
texts.en:
The Vultaum were undisputed masters at computing and virtual worlds. We will be able to use their findings to dramatically aid our own research into these fields.

Their conclusions are troubling, however. At first glance they appear to be fundamentally flawed nonsense, but upon deeper inspection they seem to have elements of truth to them.

If we wish to delve deeper, we will require additional time and resources.

texts.zh: 尽管在结论上存在着根本性缺陷，沃陶姆在计算机及虚拟世界领域极其先进，能够极大的帮助我们的相关研究。
texts.en: Despite the fundamentally flawed conclusions, the Vultaum research into computing and virtual worlds was highly advanced and will dramatically aid our own studies.

label.zh: 我们会好好利用已学到的知识。
label.en: We will put what we have already learned to good use.

label.zh: 继续深挖，我们一定要学到他们知道的一切。
label.en: Dig deeper. We must know everything they learned.

label.zh: 狂热唯物主义常规帝国

title.zh: 进一步研究沃陶姆的秘密
title.en: Delve Deeper into the Secrets of the Vultaum

texts.zh:
我们不能仅仅因为害怕可能的后果就放弃追寻真相。沃陶姆发现的某些东西撕碎了他们的现实。

我们无所畏惧。
texts.en:
We cannot stop searching for the truth just because the implications may be disturbing. The Vultaum found something that shattered their reality.

We are unafraid.

texts.zh:
看起来，沃陶姆竟然有可能是对的。

我们重复了他们的实验，然后得到了相近的结论。我们有一定可能真的存在于一个虚拟世界中。

我们缺乏足够的信息，无法得知是谁因为什么理由才会创造这样一个世界。但可以肯定的是，没有人会残酷到仅仅因为好玩就创造一个宇宙。

这件事情的影响是深远的，我们现在恭敬的请求您下一步的指示。
texts.en:
It seems that the Vultaum may have been correct after all.

We have replicated their experiments and come to similar conclusions. There is a moderate chance that we are, in fact, existing within a simulated world.

We do not have enough data to hypothesize why someone would create such a thing. Surely no one would create a universe as cruel and cold as this one for simple enjoyment.

The implications of this are profound, and we yield to your discretion as to our next steps.

label.zh: 令人不安，封锁这个调查的相关信息。
5天后的一种随机结果（50%）；须仍存在负责研究的科学家
label.en: One random outcome after5days (50%); the leading research scientist must still exist

公众因得知真相而感到困扰。
沃陶姆的秘密被替换为：
tooltips.en:
The public are disturbed by the revelation.
Secrets of the Vultaum is replaced with:

texts.zh:
我们遗憾的通知您，领导沃陶姆研究项目的科学家[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]并未决定停止研究沃陶姆。

他们留下的笔记开始变得逻辑混乱，直至成为胡言乱语。他们随之决定要“继续研究”，此后不久便自杀了。
texts.en:
We regret to inform you that [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName] did not take the decision to end the research into the Vultaum well.

The notes they left behind drift off into mad ramblings before coming to the decision to 'continue the research', shortly before committing suicide.

texts.zh:
报告表明，[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]已经饱受领导沃陶姆研究的压力影响。

他们开始能够进行难以置信的逻辑跳跃，使得我们的研究大大受益，但是同时他们也不得不自行用药治疗，以作为高压下的应对机制。
texts.en:
Reports indicate that the stress of leading the research into the Vultaum has affected [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName].

They have begun to make incredible leaps of logic that are greatly aiding our research, but have also begun self-medicating as a coping mechanism.

texts.zh: 报告称，[leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName]已经开始能够进行难以想象的逻辑跳跃，这使我们的研究项目受益匪浅。
texts.en: Reports indicate that [leading_vultaum_research_scientist.GetName] has benefited greatly the research project, and has begun to make incredible leaps of logic that are greatly aiding our research.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]的一个巨大弹坑底部发现了一个小型的沃陶姆氦-3矿产基地，这个弹坑似乎就是由这个基地的内部爆炸而形成的，看来他们的采矿技术与我们的截然不同，否则仅仅是仪器操作失误或者普通事故是绝不可能造成如此可怕的爆炸。
texts.en: Remnants of a small Vultaum helium-3 mining base have been found at the bottom of a large crater on [From.GetName]. The blast that created the crater seems to have originated from inside the facility itself. Unless Vultaum mining techniques were radically different from our own, an equipment failure or accident cannot account for such a massive explosion.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的火山口从前是一个古老的沃陶姆采矿基地。在其附近会建立一个考古挖掘地来寻找遗迹里有用的东西。
texts.en: A crater on [From.GetName] was once the site of an ancient Vultaum mining base. An archaeological dig site will be established nearby to search the ruins for anything useful.

texts.zh: 奇迹般地，我们从[From.From.GetName]坑洞中炸飞的沃陶姆数据核心上回收了一部分数据。大部分的数据都已损坏，但我们的科学家成功翻译出了“科尔加”这个代表沃陶姆基本时间单位的单词。
texts.en: Miraculously, we managed to salvage parts of a Vultaum data core that had been blown clear of the crater on [From.From.GetName]. Most of the data was corrupt, but our scientists did manage to properly translate the "korga" - the basic Vultaum time unit.

title.zh: 发现沃陶姆的母星星系

texts.zh: 在这之后，我们的科学家加班加点的修复了沃陶姆在[Root.Capital.GetName]上所留的文物，并成功推导出沃陶穆尔所在的确切星系坐标——古老的沃陶姆文明的家园恒星系！我们应当抢在别的文明捷足先登之前对这个星系进行考察。
texts.en: After intense study of our recovered Vultaum artifacts, scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName] have managed to deduce the exact galactic coordinates of Vultaumar - the home system of the ancient Vultaum civilization! We should launch an expedition to this system before someone else beats us to it.

texts.zh: 我们已经发现了沃陶姆文明母恒星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船前去探索！
texts.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Vultaum home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

texts.zh: 我们已经定位了沃陶姆母恒星系的坐标。
texts.en: We now have the coordinates of the Vultaum home system.

notes.zh: 六份线索完成后定位母星。首次生成若暂缺合适星系，每30天重试；成功或已存在时，两天后收到通知。之后仍须完成母星调查。
notes.en: After six clues, locate the home system. If initial placement lacks a suitable system, retry every 30 days; successful placement or an existing system produces the notice after 2 days. The homeworld project still follows.

texts.zh:
沃陶姆母星破碎的残骸显示了它在1200万年前遭受了灭绝性的打击，起因是某种反物质仪器的引爆。从[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]表面残留的废墟中，我们了解到沃陶姆帝国曾在消灭前经历过巨大的思想转变。

他们新的哲学认为整个宇宙都不过是一个更高级的存在用来享乐的虚拟现实系统，所有智慧生物都被接入这个系统而毫不知情。不少沃陶姆人采取越发极端的尝试与其“断开连接”，其中很多人都选择了自杀。

最终他们总结出，只有数十亿个体同时断连，才足以破坏整个系统的稳定，使他们重获自由。于是在一个约定的时间，宇宙各处所有的沃陶姆人开始用任何可能的手段自杀。而那些拒绝参加大规模自杀的人实在太少，无法继续正常的繁衍，沃陶姆文明因此逐渐消散，最终灰飞烟灭。
texts.en:
The shattered remnants of the Vultaum homeworld reveal that it underwent a massive extinction event 12 million years ago, caused by the detonation of some kind of antimatter device. From the ruins that remain on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, we have learned that Vultaum society experienced a radical ideological shift a century before their extinction.

Their new philosophy posited that the entire universe was an artificial reality which all sapient beings had been unwittingly plugged into for the amusement of some higher power. The Vultaum undertook increasingly radical attempts to forcefully "disconnect" themselves from this simulation, most of which involved mass suicide.

They finally concluded that only the simultaneous disconnection of billions of individuals would destabilize the system enough to grant them freedom. At an agreed upon hour, Vultaum everywhere killed themselves by any means available. Those who refused to take part in this mass suicide were too few to repopulate the species, and so the Vultaum faded into obscurity and eventual extinction.

tooltips.zh: 解锁稀有文物行动：沃陶姆的秘密
tooltips.en: Minor Artifact Action Unlocked: Secrets of the Vultaum

texts.zh: 沃陶姆人古老破碎的母星已经被发现，但显然已经有人捷足先登了。[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上尚存价值的东西已经所剩无几。
texts.en: The shattered homeworld of the ancient Vultaum has been found, but it has clearly been visited by someone else recently. Nothing of value remains to be found on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: 根据我们的调查数据显示，这个残破的星球是一个叫做“沃陶姆”的古老文明的母星，这里已经被其他最近到访的宇宙文明扫荡过了，现在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]上已经没有任何有价值的残骸了。
texts.en: According to our survey data, this broken world once served as the homeworld of an ancient civilization known as the "Vultaum." There are signs that other spacefarers visited here recently... nothing of value remains to be found on the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon].

tooltips.zh: 解锁稀有文物行动：沃陶姆的秘密
tooltips.en: Minor Artifact Action Unlocked: Secrets of the Vultaum

title.zh: 发现沃陶姆的母星星系

texts.zh: [From.GetName]的考古学家们已经设法推断出沃陶姆母星系的秘密坐标！
texts.en: Archeologists from the [From.GetName] have managed to deduce the secret location of the Vultaum home system!

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]表面发现了一个古老的沃陶姆观测站，[From.GetStarName]系统距离沃陶姆的发源地相当遥远，这个设施似乎也是主要被用来观测他们自己的恒星的。我们已经浏览了一边观测站还残存的数据，但是完全不知道沃陶姆到底在他们的观测站里寻找什么。
texts.en:
An ancient Vultaum observatory has been found on the surface of [From.GetName]. The [From.GetStarName] system is fairly distant from the region of space where the Vultaum originated, and this facility appears to have been primarily used for the observation of their own stars.

We have gone over the observatory's surviving data, but there are no clues as to exactly what the Vultaum were searching for in their observations.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]之前有一个沃陶姆天文台，一个远离他们古老帝国的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。考古学家对分析研究这个天文台遗址充满兴趣。
texts.en: There was once a Vultaum observatory on [From.GetName], a [From.GetPlanetMoon] that lies quite some distance away from their ancient empire. Archeologists are eager to study the abandoned ruins.

texts.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]进行的考古发掘在一座天文台一间布满灰尘的小屋中发现了一张小型壁画。上面似乎描绘了数个星座，如从沃陶姆主星观察应该可以看见。我们的天文学家目前还不能确定其中的任何一颗星球。
texts.en: The archaeological dig on [From.From.GetName] has uncovered a small mural in one of the observatory's dust-covered smaller chambers. It seems to depict several different constellations, possibly as they would appear if viewed from the Vultaum homeworld. Our astronomers have not been able to identify the individual stars.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的赤道附近的[Root.GetName]发现了已经崩塌的沃陶姆空间电梯的残骸。电梯的对重部分位于沃陶姆同步轨道外，仿佛有人故意在那个部位将整个电梯截断。根据遗迹来判断，巨大的线缆坠落在位于赤道附近的几个主要城市中心区。估计这次事故至少造成了数百万的伤亡。
texts.en: The partial remains of a collapsed Vultaum space elevator have been discovered by the [Root.GetName] in one of the equatorial regions on [From.GetName]. It seems the elevator was intentionally severed at its counterweight beyond geostationary orbit, collapsing the massive cable on top of several major urban centers along the equator. Judging by the ruins, the resulting death toll must have been in the millions.

texts.zh: 有一座属于沃陶姆的已经崩毁了的太空电梯依然环绕在[From.GetName]的赤道轨道上。显然这里藏有大量的文物，在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的表面建立一作考察站一定是明智之举。
texts.en: A collapsed Vultaum space elevator can be found near the equator on [From.GetName]. There are surely many artifacts to be found if an archaeological dig site is established on the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.From.GetName]的考古学家在破碎的电梯电缆旁边找到了星图的残片。显然沃陶姆商舰队的队长用过这个星图，星图上标注着几条他们最常用的、获利最大的星际贸易路线。
texts.en: Our archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have managed to recover the partial remains of a star chart next to a broken segment of elevator cable. It was apparently used by captains in the Vultaum merchant marine, and it shows several of their most lucrative interstellar trade routes.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]表面有几个巨大的圆形湖泊是由数百万年的一系列反物质爆炸形成的，那时，[From.GetPlanetMoon]还是有沃陶姆人居住的，而弹坑所在处在当时都是他们最大的几个居住站之一。[Root.GetName]的科学家已经排除了轨道轰炸的可能性，因此我们相信这些爆炸可能是当时地面上的人造成的。
texts.en:
Several large, perfectly circular lakes on the surface of [From.GetName] were caused by a series of massive antimatter explosions several million years ago. This [From.GetPlanetMoon] was inhabited by the Vultaum at that point, and the craters are all clustered in the region that housed their largest planetary settlements.

Orbital bombardment has been ruled out by the science staff on the [Root.GetName], leading us to believe that these explosions were triggered by someone or something on the ground.

texts.zh: 一座位于[From.GetName]的陨石坑集群里的大都会遗址曾是一座沃陶姆的主要都市。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
texts.en: A collection of large craters on [From.GetName] was once a major Vultaum metropolis. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate potential artifacts.

texts.zh: [From.From.GetName]上的考古学家在一座倒塌的医疗中心里的一个终端机上回收了完整的存储核心，其中保存着一些有趣的记录，比如沃陶姆的自然平均寿命（大概270年）以及一些他们常患的疾病。
texts.en: The archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have managed to recover an intact memory core from a terminal inside a crumbling medical facility. It contained some interesting statistics, such as the average natural Vultaum lifespan (roughly 270 years) and a list of their most common diseases.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: 在对[From.GetName]进行了一次彻底的扫描之后，我们发现了在[From.GetPlanetMoon]的地表下有一个大规模、人造的地下网络系统，许多隧道都已经崩塌了，[Root.GetName]的一支小队认为这只是沃陶姆地下殖民地的很小一部分。进入地下洞穴的主入口被故意摧毁了，沃陶姆的城市和居民们都被数百万吨巨石压在了地下。
texts.en:
A thorough scan of [From.GetName] has revealed a vast, artificially-constructed network of tunnels beneath the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Most of the tunnels have collapsed, and the crew of the [Root.GetName] believe they represent only a small portion of what was once a much larger subterranean Vultaum colony.

The main underground caverns were intentionally collapsed, crushing the Vultaum cities and their inhabitants under several million tons of rock.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆核心殖民地崩溃前，此处曾是一个巨大的隧道网络。派遣考察队来这里挖掘显然是非常有必要的。
texts.en: There was once a vast tunnel network on [From.GetName] that housed a major Vultaum colony before its collapse. An archaeological dig site is needed to excavate the ruins.

texts.zh: 在[From.From.GetName]进行的考古挖掘中，在离地面很近的其中一间倒塌密室里发现了一些令人惊讶的沃陶姆种群化石遗骸。这让科学家们得以进一步了解沃陶姆种群的真实样貌。
texts.en: The archaeological dig on [From.From.GetName] has unearthed some remarkable fossilized Vultaum remains from one of the collapsed chambers closest to the surface. This has given our scientists a much clearer picture of what the Vultaum actually looked like.

texts.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星附近有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization in the vicinity of this gas giant.

title.zh: 沃陶姆气态巨行星设施

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]附近的轨道上发现了沃陶姆人的采气站的部分残骸，数百万年前，沃陶姆本意是将这个采气站直接送入气态巨行星的内部，但是一次不明物体的撞击使这个计划失败了。
texts.en: We have detected the partial remains of a gas mining station in orbit around [From.GetName] which appears Vultaum in origin. Its station-keeping thrusters were deliberately fired millions of years ago in an attempt to push the station directly into the gas giant, but a collision with an unknown object prevented this from happening.

texts.zh: 沃陶姆气体开采站的一部分仍然环绕着[From.GetName]。种种迹象标明这里曾经遭受过劫掠，但我们的考古专家坚信这里仍然还留有重要物品有待发现。
texts.en: The partial remains of a Vultaum gas mining station still orbit [From.GetName]. The derelict facility has been looted before, but our archaeologists are confident there are still discoveries to be made.

texts.zh: 我们的考古学家发现了一件之前的掠夺者漏掉的近乎完整的沃陶姆宇航服，这件四米长、长得像管子一样的衣服让我们的科学家对适宜沃陶姆生存的环境有了新一步的了解。
texts.en: A mostly intact Vultaum space suit that previous looters had somehow overlooked has been recovered by our archaeologists. This four meter long, tube-like construct has given our scientists new insights into what kind of environments the Vultaum preferred.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是一个小型前哨，前哨中的人会与其他临近文明的人进行贸易上的来往，从某种程度上来说，这个贸易点的任务到后来已经演变成了发展信念。沃陶姆人试图让外来的商人皈依他们的信念。贸易后来很快就终止了，最后[From.GetPlanetMoon]也被遗弃了。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was home to a small Vultaum outpost where they traded with several neighboring civilizations. At some point the trade post appears to have been converted into a religious mission, where the Vultaum attempted to convert visiting alien merchants to their philosophy. Trade ceased shortly afterward, and the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was eventually abandoned.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上曾一度有一个沃陶姆贸易站。挖掘出遗迹需要很大工夫，但考古学家认为这是值得的。
texts.en: A Vultaum trade post could once be found on [From.GetName]. The abandoned ruins need to be properly excavated, but our archaeologists assure us it would be worth the effort.

texts.zh: [From.From.GetName]上的考古学家在挖掘中发现了一个沃陶姆小型电子书册。应该是这个据点的传教士曾把这些小册子递给来往的商旅队。书册上大部分数据都丢失了，里面只保留有一些关于“天大的谎言”和“虚拟现实的桎梏”的条目。
texts.en: Archaeologists on [From.From.GetName] have salvaged a small Vultaum digital pamphlet. It seems the missionaries at this outpost passed pamphlets like this on to visiting merchants. Most of the data is corrupt, but there are several references to "the great lie" and "the shackles of virtual reality."

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]发现了一个小型沃陶姆卫星，它的功能就是不断重复发送一个信息直到能源耗尽，我们拿出了它的发信器，但是只能从中提取出一小部分的信息。这颗卫星的主要目的就是用来向附近的文明公告沃陶姆的哲学理念，主要包含了“断开连接”和“拥抱真实的存在”，天知道这是什么意思。
texts.en:
A small Vultaum satellite was found in orbit of [From.GetName]. It had been set up to continuously repeat a message until its power source drained millions of years ago. We salvaged its transmitter array but could only recover a small portion of the transmission.

The main purpose of this satellite was apparently to preach the dominant Vultaum philosophy to neighboring civilizations. Its message speaks of the need to "disconnect" and to "embrace true existence," whatever that means.

texts.zh: 一颗古老的沃陶姆人造卫星正在[From.GetName]的引力轨道上磕磕绊绊地公转着。其发射阵列已被打捞回收，我们的数据工程师正如饥似渴地分析着设备。
texts.en: An ancient Vultaum satellite was stumbled upon in orbit of [From.GetName]. Its transmitter array has been salvaged, and our data engineers are anxious to analyze the equipment.

texts.zh: 我们的考古学家和数据工程师在对沃陶姆发信器进行彻底的分析之后，认为其中没有任何对我们有用的技术。这个项目增加了我们对沃陶姆编程语言的了解，如此我们日后如有破译需求，就不会那么困难了。
texts.en: After careful analysis of the Vultaum transmitter array, our archaeologists and data engineers have concluded that the machinery does not contain any technologies of value to us. The project has greatly improved our understanding of the primary Vultaum programming language, however. This will hopefully make it easier to decipher their data in the future.

texts.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

sections.zh: 这个宜居星球上存在古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this habitable world.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是沃陶姆殖民地中比较特殊的一个地方，有两个原因：1、[From.GetStarName]曾经并不属于沃陶姆，2、这里的遗迹的年份要比其他地方要晚很多。这里似乎是一些被沃陶姆主体排斥的居民居住的地方。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was the site of a small Vultaum colony that is unique for two reasons - the [From.GetStarName] system is not within what used to be Vultaum space, and the ruins are several centuries younger than anything else left by their civilization. The colony seems to have been settled by some kind of splinter group that rejected their society's dominant philosophy.

texts.zh: 我们发现了一片位于[From.GetName]上的沃陶姆分裂者殖民地。一旦我们的考察开始进行，我们就可以发现很多有价值的文物。
texts.en: We have discovered what appears to be the ruins of a Vultaum splinter colony on [From.GetName]. Once a dig site has been set up, our archaeologists can begin excavating the ruins for valuable artifacts.

texts.zh: [From.From.GetName]的考古现场挖掘出的一些文物上面写有反对沃陶姆的“生命本身就是一个谎言”这一哲学理念的字迹。其中一件文物似乎是对整个沃陶姆种群的一种纪念。这进一步验证了我们的理论：这个分离出来的殖民地在其他沃陶姆恒星众崩溃之后，依然继续存在了一段时间。
texts.en: Several artifacts excavated at the archaeological dig site on [From.From.GetName] are covered in writing that firmly rejects the Vultaum philosophical idea that "life itself is a lie." One of them appears to be a memorial of sorts to the Vultaum race as a whole. This would confirm our theory that this splinter colony existed for some time after the collapse of the rest of the Star Assembly.

texts.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

sections.zh: 在这颗荒凉的巨石上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this inhospitable rock.

texts.zh: 沃陶姆工程师在[From.GetName]附近建造一个巨大的轨道用以计算机研究。但奇怪的是，他们似乎并不关注人工智能领域，而是全身心地投入了虚拟现实系统和超级计算机模拟技术，大部分建筑都被炮火和小流星摧毁了，但是还是不少较为完好的建筑残存。
texts.en: Vultaum engineers at some point built a massive orbital complex near [From.GetName] dedicated to computer research. Strangely, they seem to have ignored the normally popular field of artificial intelligence to focus exclusively on virtual realities and massive computer simulations. Most of the complex has been ruined by weapons fire and micrometeoroids, but what remains is in remarkable condition given the station's age.

texts.zh: 一副空荡荡的轨道复合体的金属框架漂浮在[From.GetName]的外空间区域。其建成目的似乎是有关虚拟现实研究，但是如果我们要了解更多相关信息的话，就需要进行一次适当的考古调查。
texts.en: The metal skeleton of a massive Vultaum orbital complex has been found above [From.GetName]. Its purpose seems to have been virtual reality research, but a proper archaeological survey needs to be conducted if we are to learn more.

texts.zh: 考古学家在调查位于[From.From.GetName]之上的沃陶姆行星轨道群时，发现了一个有趣的东西。他们找到了昔日沃陶姆帝国几十亿居民都很喜欢的一款多用户虚拟现实游戏。尽管这个游戏只是虚构了一个对沃陶姆现实情况进行辛辣讽刺的虚拟世界，但这款游戏对于研究沃陶姆种群的语言和风俗来说仍是无价之宝。
texts.en:
The archaeologists investigating the Vultaum orbital complex above [From.From.GetName] have stumbled upon an interesting find. They managed to recover a partial copy of what was apparently a fairly popular multi-user virtual reality game enjoyed by billions of Vultaum across their empire.

Although the game takes place in a fictional and highly satirized version of their contemporary society, it has proved an invaluable source of information on both their language and customs.

texts.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
texts.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
sections.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

title.zh: 沃陶姆小行星采矿基地

texts.zh: [From.GetName]是在有小行星碰撞造成的陨石坑中发现的，但是有一个坑非常特殊——这似乎是某种反物质仪器爆炸造成的。这颗小行星上表面的另外一处证据表明在1200万年前，有很多沃陶姆在这里从事采矿。我们发现的其中一个较大的坑应该就是开采空间站。
texts.en: [From.GetName] is covered in impact craters from asteroid collisions, but one stands out - it appears to have been created through the detonation of some kind of antimatter device. There is evidence elsewhere on the asteroid's surface indicating that it was heavily mined by the Vultaum at some point roughly 12 million years ago. The large crater we found was presumably the location of their mining outpost.

texts.zh: 这个位于[From.GetName]小行星上的矿物采掘基地如今就只剩下一个巨大的陨石坑了。然而初步地质扫描显示，他们的一些采矿坑道可能完好地保存在地表之下。
texts.en: A massive crater is all that remains of an ancient Vultaum mining base on asteroid [From.GetName]. Preliminary scans suggest that some of their mining tunnels may have survived, however.

texts.zh: 对[From.From.GetName]上的被摧毁的沃陶姆采矿基地进行一番勘测后，在一条保存完好的地道中发现了一些被遗弃的采矿设备。这些采矿设备特别针对沃陶姆人民的虫型身体结构所设计，并由他们进行沟通时所发出的独有的身体震动来操纵。
texts.en: A closer examination of the destroyed Vultaum mining base on [From.From.GetName] has uncovered some of their abandoned mining equipment in a surviving tunnel. It was uniquely designed for use with their worm-like anatomy, and appears to have been operated primarily through the body vibrations they used to communicate.

texts.zh: 远古时期沃陶姆的母星。昔日辉煌尚可见一斑。
texts.en: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.

sections.zh: 远古时期沃陶姆的母星。昔日辉煌尚可见一斑。
sections.en: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.

summary.text:
# 沃陶姆：对现实的怀疑

> 含先驱者调查与秘密研究结局。本文为人工审读导读，不是游戏原文。调查地点的逐篇细读及整链浏览器验收仍未完成。

## 故事概述

约一千二百万年前，沃陶姆恒星议会活跃于这片银河。这个以振动交流的环节动物文明留下了遗物，也留下了一个令人不安的问题：他们为何走向毁灭？

若率先调查母星，遗迹揭示了沃陶姆末期的思想转变。他们相信宇宙是高等存在创造的虚拟现实，试图通过大规模同时“断开连接”破坏系统。幸存者太少，文明最终消散。这是沃陶姆信念及其行为的历史，不能据此断言宇宙确实是模拟世界。

后来的秘密研究让不同文明得出不同评价。机械、蜂巢和多数常规文明可以吸收计算机知识；狂热唯物主义者则可选择停下，或再做一次研究。进一步实验得到相近结论，但原文仍只说有一定可能生活在模拟世界中，没有给出确定答案。

## 玩家顺序与分支

1. 首次发现沃陶姆遗物（precursor.1）。
2. 自由探索调查地点，每处经历发现、特殊项目、报告。累计六份线索后定位母星；不是必须依次读完十一处。
3. 母星项目之后进入率先抵达（precursor.101）或他人先到（precursor.102）的一种结果。
4. 可研究沃陶姆的秘密（VULTAUM_SECRETS → ancrel.10100）。
5. 狂热唯物主义的进一步研究选项启用VULTAUM_SECRETS_2；选择到此为止不会开启它。
6. 第二项目使用物理研究，无期限，完成后进入ancrel.10110，选择压制或公开发现。

## 十一处调查提供的线索

报告编号只用于索引，地点之间没有规定的发现顺序。

- 6：损坏的数据核心帮助译出基本时间单位“科尔加”。
- 11：天文台壁画可能呈现从母星看到的星座，但当时尚不能识别各颗恒星。它并不单独直接给出母星坐标。
- 16：破损电梯旁的商船星图保存了常用贸易路线。
- 21：医疗终端记录约270年的自然平均寿命及常见疾病。
- 26：化石让研究者进一步了解他们的形态。
- 31：一套被先前掠夺者漏掉的四米管状宇航服，揭示适宜生存的环境。
- 36：传教据点向商人散发的电子手册谈及“大谎言”与“虚拟现实的桎梏”，显示该思想曾主动传播。
- 41：发信器没有可直接利用的技术，却帮助理解沃陶姆编程语言。
- 46：分离殖民地的文物明确反对“生命是谎言”的哲学，支持这里在恒星议会崩溃后仍存续过一段时间的推断。沃陶姆并非人人接受同一种结论。
- 51：流行的多人虚拟游戏以讽刺方式描绘当时社会，是语言和习俗资料；游戏内容本身不是对整个宇宙虚拟性的证明。
- 56：矿机按照虫形身体设计，似乎主要通过他们用于交流的身体振动控制。

这些线索先让失落文明变得具体：身体、医疗、贸易、娱乐和技术。关于现实的思想与反对者只是其中一部分，最终在母星报告中汇合为文明终结的解释。

## 深入研究后的选择

压制发现：五天后按50/35/15权重选择10111、10112、10113。
公开发现：五天后按35/65权重选择10112、10113，不包含10111。

这些是互斥随机后续。三个事件执行时都要求此前记录的研究科学家仍存在；若不存在，不能将概率解读为必然出现的剧情。

- 10111：失去该领袖。
- 10112：获得或提升狂热特质，同时获得药物滥用特质与经验。
- 10113：获得或提升狂热特质与经验。

公开还有不同的帝国修正，包含研究收益与幸福度代价。两种选择不是“先压制再公开”的连续阶段。

## 遗珍激活不是下一章

precursor.105来自现实透孔仪（r_reality_perforator）的主动效果，而非母星事件自动续接。激活需要满足遗珍自身的检查并支付相应资源；它可以与探索的其他阶段相隔很久。

105使用锁定随机列表，在四种修正与2、3、4、5年持续时间构成的十六项结果中，各赋10权重；另有5权重的一项同时赋予四种修正、持续1年。这是一次激活抽取一种结果，不是顺次获得十七项奖励。权重不是直接百分比，不能把10权重写成10%。

因此它保留在附录中，供读者了解遗珍效果；不要把它强行连成调查母星或研究秘密后的必经剧情。

## 原版来源
